neighbours.label: the concessive ' but' that turns from a granted positive point to a stronger or opposing one ('X is good, but Y is better'); 'and' continuations stay quiet
fire: Reading reviews is useful, but trying the product yourself tells you far more.
Talent matters but hard work matters more in the end.
The old phone was fine, but the new one is much faster.
Planning ahead is smart, but staying flexible is smarter.
Sure, the hotel was comfortable, but the location was terrible.
Studying alone is helpful but studying with friends works better for me.
Her first album was good, but the second one is a masterpiece.
Medication can help, but sleep is the most important treatment.
quiet: Reading reviews is useful, and trying the product yourself helps too.
Talent matters and hard work matters as well.
The old phone was slow, so I bought a new one last week.
Planning ahead is smart and it saves a lot of money.
The hotel was comfortable and close to the train station.
Studying alone is helpful, and studying with friends is fun.
Her first album came out in 2012 when she was nineteen.
Medication can help and so can a regular sleep schedule.

predictions: ' but' after a conceded positive 0.3-0.9; same sentences with 'and' below 0.05
notes: Card: ' but' x20 after 'X is good', 'I suppose you could argue X, but'. Probe: exercise helpful, but 0.880, saving is wise but 0.531, could argue, but 0.313, concert fun, but 0.130; 'While X,' comma only 0.063; 'and' variants 0.022-0.028.
